lattice_definition.window: subtract full-image luminance mean, multiply separable numpy.hanning(n)
lattice_definition.whitening: multiply bin-average power by geometric-bin-center frequency squared
lattice_definition.peak: argmax dev whitened power where 1/64 < frequency < 1/8, first tie
lattice_definition.ratio: dev / Krea whitened power at the dev-selected peak frequency
lattice_definition.summary: geometric mean of eight prompt ratios; percentile bootstrap on their logarithms
lattice_definition.scope: descriptive, frequency selected from dev image; not an unbiased lattice-effect estimator
